mapper.sql: select b.bill_id, b.bill_type, b.bill_no, b.operator_id, u.user_name as operator_name, b.operate_time, b.remark, b.del_flag, b.create_by, b.create_time, b.update_by, b.update_time, ifnull(sum(d.quantity), 0) as total_quantity, count(d.detail_id) as detail_count from trace_warehouse_bill b left join sys_user u on u.user_id = b.operator_id left join trace_warehouse_bill_detail d on d.bill_id = b.bill_id and d.del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: where b.bill_id = #{billId} and b.del_flag = '0' group by b.bill_id

where b.del_flag = '0'
and b.bill_type = #{billType}
and b.bill_no like concat('%', #{billNo}, '%')
group by b.bill_id order by b.operate_time desc, b.bill_id desc

select d.detail_id, d.bill_id, d.bottling_id, bt.batch_no, bi.trace_code_prefix, bi.trace_code_start, bi.trace_code_end, (bi.trace_code_end - bi.trace_code_start + 1) as bottle_count, d.quantity, d.start_trace_code, d.end_trace_code, d.del_flag from trace_warehouse_bill_detail d left join trace_bottling_info bi on bi.bottling_id = d.bottling_id left join trace_batch bt on bt.batch_id = bi.batch_id where d.bill_id = #{billId} and d.del_flag = '0' order by d.detail_id asc
mapper.insert:
insert into trace_warehouse_bill_detail ( bill_id, bottling_id, quantity, start_trace_code, end_trace_code, create_by, create_time ) values
(#{item.billId}, #{item.bottlingId}, #{item.quantity}, #{item.startTraceCode}, #{item.endTraceCode}, #{item.createBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update trace_warehouse_bill_detail set del_flag = '2' where bill_id = #{billId}
mapper.select: select count(1) from trace_logistics where out_bill_id = #{billId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
select count(1) from trace_warehouse_bill_detail where bottling_id = #{bottlingId} and del_flag = '0' limit 1
